source: Decision table DT-2026-06-06-2 and user approval on 2026-06-06.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

next_loop.reason: The next compiler loop should start from CodeWiki source refs; the agent may refresh context when useful.

requirements.text: Actionable residual lint/audit/graph drift must not be orphaned at close/promotion gates.
Residual issue coverage must record stable issue key, classification, owner/defer/archive refs where applicable, and rationale.
Current cleanup must be planned in scoped tasks by warning class, not as a mega-task.
Lifecycle trace creation should be planned toward semantic-intent start and gate-updated lifecycle evidence.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Root cause captured from trace audit.
evidence_mapping.evidence: TASK-089 closure was narrow-correct, but broader residual drift had no durable roadmap owner; current graph reports 52 warnings and open roadmap 0.
Gateway source checks required audit refs but not audit warning status/coverage; graph source creates orphan lint reconciliation items but gateway does not consume them.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Trace timing clarified for future planning.
evidence_mapping.evidence: Graph rebuilder projects traces only from .codewiki/telemetry/TRACE-*.json and catalog.json; build approval creates validation/build nodes, not lifecycle trace nodes.

summary: Accepted residual drift coverage decision: close/promotion gates must not pass with actionable orphan residual drift; traces and planning must record ownership, deferral, archive, compatibility, or false-positive coverage for remaining warning classes.

decision_table.title: Accepted residual drift coverage decision: close/promotion gates must not pass with actionable orphan residual drift; traces and planning must record ownership, deferral, archive, compatibility, or false-positive coverage for remaining warning classes.

rows.question: RDC-001

state_delta.current: Gate validation requires audit evidence refs, but does not prove remaining audit/lint warnings are clean or durably owned.
state_delta.desired: Implementation/task-close/sprint-close/ship-ready style gates cannot pass with actionable residual drift unless every residual issue is fixed or durably covered.

rows.proposed_change: Introduce a residual issue coverage invariant: remaining actionable warnings/errors require explicit coverage as fixed, covered_by_task, covered_by_sprint, deferred_by_decision, archive_candidate, accepted_compatibility, or false_positive.
rows.rationale: The observed failure mode was orphan residual drift: current graph has 52 warnings and no open roadmap owner after earlier closure evidence claimed green/closed.

risk.notes: medium: stricter gates can block closure until old debt is classified.

options.label: Require zero warnings at all close gates; rejected because legacy debt would freeze safe progress.
Leave warnings as next-action only; rejected because roadmap can go empty while drift remains.

rows.expected_outcome: A task cannot close while warnings fall out of roadmap scope as historical/non-task without machine-readable owner/defer/archive evidence.

rows.question: RDC-002

state_delta.current: Trace/debug evidence is useful but closure reports do not preserve full audit issue snapshots or residual ownership decisions.
state_delta.desired: Trace and gate evidence capture enough residual issue context to answer what drift existed at close and why each leftover item was safe.

rows.proposed_change: Add residual_issue_coverage data to decision/planning/implementation or gateway evidence, with stable issue key, classification, owner refs, trigger/expiry where relevant, and rationale.
rows.rationale: Looking back into traces was powerful but manual because missing residual coverage forced detective work.

risk.notes: medium: schema additions must stay compact and avoid embedding raw audit payloads.

options.label: Store full raw audit transcripts in trace; rejected because traces must stay compact.
Do nothing; rejected because debugging remains manual and lossy.

rows.expected_outcome: Future trace audits can query residual coverage directly instead of reconstructing intent from build prose, validation reports, graph state, and current warnings.

rows.question: RDC-003

state_delta.current: Graph reconciliation creates lint drift items with no open roadmap coverage, but gateway pass/block policy does not consume that orphan-drift signal.
state_delta.desired: Gateway preflight/report generation blocks pass verdicts when current actionable graph reconciliation items remain uncovered.

rows.proposed_change: Teach gateway policy to compute residual coverage gaps from current lint/audit/graph state and force block on uncovered residual issues for close/promotion gates.
rows.rationale: The graph knew there were orphan lint reconciliation items, but the gate only checked audit evidence refs.

risk.notes: medium: coverage matching must avoid false blockers by supporting task/sprint/defer/archive coverage.

options.label: Only improve prompts/skills; rejected because policy must be machine-enforced.
Only show warnings in status; rejected because status was already insufficient.

rows.expected_outcome: A validator cannot close work while graph says lint drift has no open roadmap coverage.

rows.question: RDC-004

state_delta.current: Lifecycle trace nodes are currently projected only from .codewiki/telemetry/TRACE-*.json or catalog entries; legacy builds/validation are separate graph nodes.
state_delta.desired: Lifecycle traces should start at first accountable semantic intent and be updated by gates, not first appear only after gate approval.

rows.proposed_change: Plan future trace-primary behavior where decision-table/decision-loop start creates or updates the lifecycle trace, and gate pass/fail/block appends status, diagnostics, and refs.
rows.rationale: Trace audit is most valuable when it captures the full lifecycle, including failures and route-backs before approval.

risk.notes: medium: full trace-primary migration should be staged after residual-coverage gate enforcement.

options.label: Create trace only after gate pass; rejected because it loses failed/blocked debugging context.
Keep only build/validation artifacts; rejected because trace-primary architecture already targets lifecycle traces.

rows.expected_outcome: Blocked, failed, abandoned, and deferred work keeps useful trace/debug evidence from the beginning of the accountable change.

rows.question: RDC-005

state_delta.current: Current cleanup warnings are mixed: legacy decision-build deferrals, stale code path refs, missing related docs, prompt-assets ownership mismatch, tests unexpected paths, and compatibility export gaps.
state_delta.desired: Cleanup proceeds as scoped roadmap work by warning class, not one broad fix-all task.

rows.proposed_change: Route planning into a structure cleanup sprint with small tasks for warning classes and a separate enforcement task for residual coverage policy.
rows.rationale: The prior failure was partly from broad cleanup scope falling out of roadmap; scoped batches make closure auditable.

risk.notes: low: planning-only routing; implementation remains staged.

options.label: Create one mega cleanup task; rejected because it repeats the previous failure mode.
Ignore legacy warnings; rejected because orphan warnings must be owned or deferred.

rows.expected_outcome: Every current warning class is either fixed, covered by an open task/sprint, or explicitly deferred with trigger/archive evidence.
